**Management Summary – Project LV 205,800 €**

The audit identified extensive duplicate line items that could lead to double payments totaling ≈ €71,000. High‑risk duplicates include site establishment (2.1.4.50/2.1.1.10, €12,500), soil disposal (2.1.4.90/2.1.1.50, €10,080), earthwork (2.1.4.80/2.1.1.40, €6,300), frost protection (2.1.4 100/2.1.1 60, €5,760), and top‑soil handling (2.1.4 60/2.1.1 20, €3,000). Additional concerns: missing scope details for site establishment (€2,500), undefined concrete specifications (€1,480), outdated standards in soil classification (€1,232), and a foreign‑currency payment clause shifting exchange‑rate risk (€2,138). Immediate actions: consolidate duplicate positions, clarify missing specifications, and renegotiate the USD payment term to mitigate legal and financial exposure.
